title: UPSC CSE Syllabus 2026 – Prelims & Mains Complete

selectionProcess: Prelims (GS + CSAT) → Mains (9 papers) → Personality Test / Interview

shortDescription: UPSC CSE Syllabus 2026 – full Prelims (GS+CSAT) and Mains pattern with GS Paper I–IV, Essay, Optional and language papers.
content:
UPSC Civil Services Examination 2026 syllabus is defined in the official CSE notification (Appendix).

Stage 1 – Preliminary Examination

  • GS Paper I (200 marks, 2 hrs): Current events; History of India & Indian National Movement; Indian & World Geography; Indian Polity & Governance; Economic & Social Development; Environment, Ecology, Biodiversity & Climate Change; General Science.
  • CSAT / GS Paper II (200 marks, 2 hrs): Comprehension; Interpersonal skills; Logical reasoning & analytical ability; Decision making; General mental ability; Basic numeracy (Class X); Data interpretation. Qualifying – 33% minimum.

Both papers are objective (MCQ). Negative marking applies as per UPSC rules.

Stage 2 – Main Examination (Written)

  • Paper A – Indian Language (Qualifying, 300 marks)
  • Paper B – English (Qualifying, 300 marks)
  • Paper I – Essay (250)
  • Paper II – GS I: Indian Heritage, History, Geography, Society (250)
  • Paper III – GS II: Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice, IR (250)
  • Paper IV – GS III: Technology, Economic Development, Biodiversity, Environment, Security, Disaster Management (250)
  • Paper V – GS IV: Ethics, Integrity, Aptitude (250)
  • Paper VI & VII – Optional Subject Paper 1 & 2 (250 each)

Stage 3 – Personality Test

Interview / Personality Test: 275 marks. Final merit = Mains (written) + Interview.

Download the official syllabus only from upsc.gov.in.
